request.text: A program from the Downloads folder on pedro-computer keeps calling out and has turned off command-line logging for new processes. Contain host pedro-computer.

package.rationale: payload.exe (PID 3068, from pedro's Downloads, run by pedro-admin) connects to 192.168.56.40:8443 and opened and started cmd.exe, which ran reg add ...\Policies\System\Audit /v ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled /d 0 /f; the value is now 0, so new process events lose their command lines. Isolate pedro-computer.
